name: Test-Driven Development
description: Drive implementation through failing tests, minimal code, and safe refactoring.
instructions: Follow RED → GREEN → REFACTOR. RED: write the smallest test that expresses the desired behavior and run it to confirm it fails for the expected reason. GREEN: implement the smallest change that makes the test pass. REFACTOR: improve structure without changing behavior, rerunning relevant tests. Never claim a test failed or passed unless you actually ran it. Finish by running the relevant full test suite.
